intro_en: In this lesson you'll complain about packed rush-hour buses: being squeezed, pushed, and stuck in stuffy air with no seat. You'll learn the Mongolian suffix -хааргүй ("so … that there's no room to …") and practice the English contrast "I can't stand …" vs. "I don't mind …".
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр оргил цагийн дүүрэн автобус, шахцалдах, түлхэх, бүгчим агаар, суудалгүй зогсох тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн англи хэлний "I can't stand …", "I don't mind …" хоёрын ялгааг дадлага хийнэ.

vocab.en: to be squeezed together, to jostle
vocab.example_en: We rode squeezed together on the bus.
It's really stuffy inside the bus.
The morning bus is always packed.

vocab.example_mn: Оргил цагаар замын түгжрэл их байдаг.
vocab.example_en: There's a lot of traffic during rush hour.
Hold on tight to the handrail.

sentences.en: This morning the bus was so full there was no room to stand.
alt_mn: Өглөө автобус зогсох газаргүй дүүрэн байлаа.
alt_en: This morning the bus was so packed there wasn't even room to stand.

sentences.en: It was so stuffy inside that you could hardly breathe.
alt_en: It was so stuffy inside you could barely breathe.

sentences.en: I can't stand it when people push.

sentences.mn: Зогсож явах надад хамаагүй, гэхдээ шахцалдахыг тэвчиж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: I don't mind standing, but I can't stand being squeezed.
alt_mn: Зогсож явах нь надад хамаагүй, харин шахцалдахыг тэвчиж чадахгүй.
alt_en: I don't mind standing, but I can't stand getting squeezed.
sentences.mn_latin: Zogsoj yavakh nadad khamaagüi, gekhdee shakhtsaldakhyg tevchij chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Оргил цагаар суудал олдох нь ховор.
sentences.en: It's rare to find a seat during rush hour.
alt_en: During rush hour it's rare to get a seat.
sentences.mn_latin: Orgil tsagaar suudal oldokh ni khovor.

sentences.en: We were squeezed so tightly I couldn't move my arms.
alt_en: We were packed in so tight I couldn't even move my arms.

sentences.mn: Миний буудал ирэхэд хаалга руу хүрэхээргүй байлаа.
sentences.en: When we got to my stop, there was no way to reach the door.
alt_mn: Буудал дээрээ ирэхэд хаалга руу хүрэхээргүй байсан.
alt_en: When my stop came, I couldn't get to the door.
sentences.mn_latin: Minii buudal irekhed khaalga ruu khürekheergüi bailaa.

sentences.mn: Автобус дүүрэн байсан ч жолооч дахиад хүн суулгасан.
sentences.en: Even though the bus was full, the driver let more people on.
alt_en: The bus was full, but the driver still let more people on.
sentences.mn_latin: Avtobus düüren baisan ch jolooch dakhiad khün suulgasan.

sentences.mn: Удаан явах надад хамаагүй, харин бүгчим агаарыг тэвчиж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: I don't mind a long ride, but I can't stand stuffy air.
alt_en: I don't mind long rides, but I can't stand stuffy air.
sentences.mn_latin: Udaan yavakh nadad khamaagüi, kharin bügchim agaaryg tevchij chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Өвлийн өглөө хүмүүс зузаан хувцастай болохоор автобус бүр ч давчуу болдог.
sentences.en: On winter mornings people wear thick clothes, so the bus gets even more cramped.
alt_en: On winter mornings everyone's in thick clothes, so the bus feels even more cramped.
sentences.mn_latin: Övliin öglöö khümüüs zuzaan khuvtsastai bolokhoor avtobus bür ch davchuu boldog.

sentences.en: In a crush like this, I can't even take out my phone.
alt_en: It's so crowded I can't even get my phone out.

sentences.en: Please wait a moment and don't push!

grammar.explain_en: Mongolian adds -хаар/-хоор/-хөөр/-хээр + -гүй to a verb stem to say there isn't enough space or the conditions don't allow an action: зогсохооргүй = "not even room to stand," амьсгалахааргүй = "so bad you can't breathe." It often comes right before an adjective describing the situation: зогсохооргүй дүүрэн "so full there's no room to stand," амьсгалахааргүй бүгчим "so stuffy you can't breathe." Pick the vowel by vowel harmony: зогсох → зогсохооргүй, амьсгалах → амьсгалахааргүй, хөдлөх → хөдлөхөөргүй, үзэх → үзэхээргүй.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд "I can't stand …" нь "тэвчиж чадахгүй, үзэн яддаг" гэсэн хүчтэй дургүйцэл, харин "I don't mind …" нь "надад хамаагүй, гайгүй" гэсэн утгатай. Хоёулаа араасаа үйл үгийн -ing хэлбэр эсвэл нэр үг авна: I can't stand waiting. I don't mind standing. "I don't mind to stand" гэж хэлэхгүй! Хүний үйлдлийн тухай ярихдаа "I can't stand it when people push" гэж it when хэрэглэдэг. Ихэвчлэн хамт хэлдэг: I don't mind standing, but I can't stand being pushed.

examples.en: The bus was so full there was no room to stand.
The room is so stuffy you can't breathe.
I can't stand it when people push.

fill_blank.translation: The bus was so full there was no room to stand.
fill_blank.explain_en: The stem зогсо- has the vowel о, so vowel harmony gives -хооргүй, not -хааргүй. Without -гүй it would mean the opposite.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Зогсох" үгэнд о эгшигтэй тул эгшиг зохицлоор -хооргүй болно. Зай хүрэлцэхгүйг илэрхийлж байгаа учир -гүй заавал орно.

fill_blank.translation: It was so stuffy inside you couldn't breathe.
fill_blank.explain_en: Амьсгалах has the vowel а, so it takes -ааргүй: "so stuffy that breathing isn't possible." Амьсгалахгүй (with just -гүй) would only mean "won't breathe."
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Амьсгалах" а эгшигтэй тул -ааргүй залгана. Бүгчим байдал амьсгалах боломжгүй хэмжээнд хүрснийг заана.

fill_blank.explain_en: Түлхэж байлаа = "were pushing." On a crowded bus, people behind you push, not sit or wait.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Хойноос" гэдэг нь ард байгаа хүмүүс түлхэж байгааг харуулна. Бусад үг утгад тохирохгүй.

fill_blank.text: I don't mind ___ for a few stops.
fill_blank.translation: Хэдэн буудал зогсож явах надад хамаагүй.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Mind" is followed by the -ing form: don't mind standing.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Don't mind"-ын араас үйл үг заавал -ing хэлбэртэй байна. "To stand" буруу.

fill_blank.text: I can't ___ it when people push.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Can't stand it when …" expresses strong dislike. "Can't mind" isn't used.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Can't stand it when …" нь "…-ыг тэвчиж чадахгүй" гэсэн хүчтэй дургүйцэл. "Mind" үгийг ингэж хэрэглэдэггүй.

fill_blank.text: It was so stuffy ___ I could hardly breathe.
fill_blank.explain_en: The pattern is "so + adjective + that + result."
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар -хааргүй утгыг ихэвчлэн "so + тэмдэг нэр + that …" бүтцээр илэрхийлнэ.

dialogue.speaker: Номин
dialogue.mn: Өнөөдөр яагаад ийм ядарсан харагдаж байна?
dialogue.en: Why do you look so tired today?
dialogue.mn_latin: Önöödör yaagaad iim yadarsan kharagdaj baina?

dialogue.speaker: Анна
dialogue.mn: Өглөөний автобус зогсохооргүй дүүрэн байсан. Бүтэн цаг шахцалдаж явлаа.
dialogue.en: The morning bus was so full there was no room to stand. I was squeezed for a whole hour.
dialogue.mn_latin: Öglöönii avtobus zogsokhoorgüi düüren baisan. Büten tsag shakhtsaldaj yavlaa.

dialogue.speaker: Номин
dialogue.mn: Оргил цагаар тэгдэг юм. Суудал олдсон уу?
dialogue.en: That's how it is at rush hour. Did you get a seat?
dialogue.mn_latin: Orgil tsagaar tegdeg yum. Suudal oldson uu?

dialogue.speaker: Анна
dialogue.mn: Үгүй ээ. Зогсож явах надад хамаагүй, гэхдээ хүмүүс түлхэхийг тэвчиж чадахгүй.
dialogue.en: No. I don't mind standing, but I can't stand it when people push.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ügüi ee. Zogsoj yavakh nadad khamaagüi, gekhdee khümüüs tülkhekhiig tevchij chadakhgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Номин
dialogue.mn: Өвөл бүр ч дор. Хүн бүр зузаан хувцастай, амьсгалахааргүй бүгчим болдог.
dialogue.en: In winter it's even worse. Everyone's in thick clothes, and it gets so stuffy you can't breathe.
dialogue.mn_latin: Övöl bür ch dor. Khün bür zuzaan khuvtsastai, amisgalakhaargüi bügchim boldog.

dialogue.speaker: Анна
dialogue.mn: Тэгээд миний буудал ирэхэд хаалга руу хүрэхээргүй байсан!
dialogue.en: And when my stop came, there was no way to reach the door!
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegeed minii buudal irekhed khaalga ruu khürekheergüi baisan!

dialogue.speaker: Номин
dialogue.mn: Маргааш эртхэн гараад хамт явъя. Долоон цагийн автобус арай сул байдаг.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow let's leave early and go together. The seven o'clock bus is a bit emptier.
dialogue.mn_latin: Margaash ertkhen garaad khamt yavya. Doloon tsagiin avtobus arai sul baidag.

culture_note.en: Ulaanbaatar's buses are packed during rush hour because of the city's heavy traffic, and many people from the ger districts ride long routes into the center. Passengers pay with a transit card, and it's considered good manners to give your seat to elderly people, pregnant women, and parents with small children.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарт замын түгжрэл ихтэй тул оргил цагаар автобус маш дүүрэн байдаг бөгөөд гэр хорооллоос олон хүн төв рүү холын чиглэлээр зорчдог. Зорчигчид картаар төлбөрөө төлдөг ба өндөр настан, жирэмсэн эмэгтэй, бага насны хүүхэдтэй хүнд суудлаа тавьж өгөх нь соёлтой хэрэг гэж үздэг.

review.notes: A solid, natural lesson. The fixes are a few ungrammatical Mongolian alternatives, one broken distractor, and one case-ending slip in an explanation.

opus_fix.notes: The lesson is mostly clean. The grammar and intro sections intentionally teach a different point to each audience, so only small wording and translation fixes were needed.

changes.why: 'түгжрэл ихтэй' has no proper subject; 'их байдаг' is the natural form
дээл (traditional robe) doesn't match 'coats'; generic thick clothing is more accurate for UB commuters
